Triodos Investment Management passed an important regulatory hurdle in 2021 following the successful assessment of its MiFID II competencies, allowing the company to now offer investment MiFID-services to institutional professional clients.
In 2022, we will further embed flexible working in the organisation including our policies.
The balance of men and women in total was 53% (52% in 2020) and 47% (48% in 2020) respectively and in management positions 33% (41% in 2020) was female.
The average age of the co-worker group in 2021 was 42 years, unchanged compared to 2020.
The attrition rate increased to 11% in 2021 (7% in 2020).
The investment funds overall gained 6% of their value following stock exchange movements in 2021.

At the same time, the cost increase was dampened due to lower than anticipated travel expenses following COVID-19 restrictions, just like in 2020.
Due to a likely tax obligation, a provision for the amount of EUR 2.2 million has been made for the carried interest amount received in 2019.
